notes.title: Prison Remedium BUNDLE is here!
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Together with the Baked Games Team, we have prepared a unique bundle that will guarantee hours of entertainment. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25854424/69c45f06b257246fc47347033ac059e1247eeb65.png

Try yourself in two different roles! As a tough prison guard or a nanobot.

The bundle will give you access to:
- Project Remedium
- Prison Simulator

About:

Project Remedium is a story-driven action shooter set inside a human body devastated by illness and bad circumstances. It's a post-apocalypse of sorts, a really tiny one, but for a nanobot named Nano+, the body is a whole world. 

Prison Simulator get a taste of prison life! Become a prison guard and deal with dangerous convicts. Prison management, lots of daily activities. As a prison guard, your job is to maintain order behind the prison walls.


JOIN OUR DISCORD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25854424/fabd4c56edd673cc3261064c9d6f80bee0b8ff51.png 


Have a good one!
Atomic Jelly Team

notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/fcf2f54e078cd7073765a5c2fdb6bad449556744.png

For quite some time we have been working on needed fixes to the game. It should work better and faster. We are still working on some optimization tweaks so stay tuned. We are very sorry for being so quiet lately. Despite the large amount of work, we have not forgotten about You and we still care and support our nanobots team. You can find a full changelog below.


FIX


 added caching to the minimap (loading times should go down by a lot)
 cached the minimaps on all levels where the they're needed
 added new graphic settings to greatly improve gameplay on low spec PCs
 fixed broken achievements


Cheers,
Atomic Jelly
